title: Reverting/blocklisted reward recipient bricks the V2->V3 migration chunk (no in-contract recovery)
description: migrate iterates recipients and safeTransfers the reward inside an unskippable loop (L186-194). A single reverting/blocklisted recipient reverts the whole chunk and pins migrateIterator at the offending index. The reseed guard (L114, require !seeded || migrateIterator == -1) makes the documented straggler-exclusion escape unreachable, and withdrawAll (L216-229) is a pure balance sweep that does not reset migrateIterator, so it cannot break the deadlock either. The one-time V2->V3 migration cannot complete without redeploy+rewire.
impact: No theft. Availability/liveness: the migration bricks with no in-contract recovery. Users retain their V2 positions and stranded balances are recoverable via withdrawAll; only migration liveness is lost. Owner-recoverable by deploying a fresh migrator and re-wiring via setMigrator on both V2 and V3.
attackPath: Migration list includes a reward recipient that reverts on receipt (e.g. a USDC-blocklisted / frozen address, or a contract with a reverting fallback).
migrate iterates recipients and calls safeTransfer of the reward inside a loop with no per-recipient skip.
The reverting recipient reverts the whole chunk transaction; migrateIterator stays pinned and never reaches -1.
Re-seeding to exclude the straggler requires migrateIterator == -1 (L114 guard) which the brick prevents; withdrawAll does not reset the pass.
Only recovery is full redeploy + setMigrator rewire.
recommendation: Make reward forwarding skippable/bankable per recipient (try/catch or bank failed transfers) so one reverting recipient cannot brick the whole chunk, and/or allow a controlled mid-pass reseed to exclude a straggler.
priorArtCrossRef: ledger V2-M-01 (same availability-DoS class on the retired MigratorV1V2; NEW contract + different root cause — NOT a fingerprint collision)
specConformanceCrossRef: F-01 (V3-F-01) — documented in-contract recovery path is unreachable while bricked (story-023)
